name: Aquarium Care

pf.license.need: None for aquarium care in most places: a business registration, the business's own word. Where the state's rules require a pet or animal dealer license to sell live fish, corals or other animals, the business says it holds one (a generic switch) before livestock is sold at a visit.
ask: the business registration (the business's own word)
a pet or animal dealer license, only where the state's rules require one to sell livestock (the business's own word)
liability insurance, as the business says
pf.license.check: None: Rosie doesn't look up or check any registration, dealer license or insurance (D96). The business says what it holds.
pf.license.blocks: A required dealer license the business says it doesn't hold keeps livestock sales off (care visits stay on).
pf.license.renewals: The business's own record of renewal dates. A lapse the owner reports stops the work it covers.
pf.license.insurance: Liability insurance for water damage in the customer's home, as the business says.
pf.license.limits: No electrical or plumbing work: a new outlet, a dedicated circuit or a plumbed water line is an electrician's or plumber's job and is never booked; tanks on a stand or floor the tech judges unsafe are not filled
pf.license.otherwise: identity: the code the customer gets on their own phone (D66); customers see no license claim

pf.services.shape: visits to homes and offices to care for aquariums (a water change, glass and decor cleaning, filter care, a water test, a livestock check), one time or on a repeat plan; trouble visits priced at the visit; tank moves and new setups quoted from photos first; at the shop: water tests and fish holding
pf.services.examples: the example business's own prices, not a standard

list.name: Tank care visit, freshwater, up to 75 gallons
list.where: at the customer's home or office
list.after: the saved card charged at DONE

list.name: Tank care visit, saltwater or reef, up to 75 gallons
list.after: the saved card charged at DONE

list.name: Bigger tanks
list.kind: one price from the list, by tank size

list.name: Repeat care plan
list.price: the visit's own price each time (example)
list.kind: every 2 weeks or every month, same day and window
list.after: the saved card charged at each DONE
list.note: the plan's own yes first; nothing charged between visits

list.name: Office or restaurant account
list.price: the visit prices, on one bill a month (example)
list.after: Rosie sends one bill a month for the visits

list.name: Tank trouble visit (cloudy water, a heater or pump that stopped, a small leak, fish dying)
list.price: $85 trip and check (example); the fix priced at the visit
list.after: the saved card charged at DONE

list.name: Tank move, or a new tank set up
list.price: quoted from photos and the tank size (example: a 90-gallon reef moved and set up, $1,200)
list.after: the rest on the bill when it's set up

list.name: Water test and fish check at the shop
list.price: $15 (example); a basic water test is free
list.after: paid at the counter, or nothing for the free test

list.after: paid at the counter at pick-up

pf.services.capacity: one tech per care visit; two techs for a move or a tank over 75 gallons
pf.services.nobody_home: yes for care visits on a plan: a key, lockbox or doorman, set on the secure page; never for a first visit, a move or a setup

beforeTimes: at the shop or at your place
one visit or a repeat plan
for trouble: what's wrong (cloudy water, a leak, equipment stopped, fish dying)
afterTime: where the tank is (the floor, stairs)
a sink or tub near the tank for water
the fish and corals in it
securePage: the way in when nobody is home (a key, lockbox, alarm or gate code, doorman)
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult: the tank's owner or someone they authorize (an office manager for an office tank)

stop_words: water leaking near outlets, a power strip or cords
a shock from the tank water or equipment
sparks, smoke or a burning smell from a heater, light or pump
the glass cracked or the tank burst and water spreading
a sting from a lionfish or another venomous animal
coral toxin in the eyes or mouth, or trouble breathing after handling coral rock
pf.safety.stop_action: water and power: don't touch the water or the equipment; switch off the tank's circuit at the breaker only if it can be reached without standing in water; a shock, a sting with trouble breathing, coral toxin in the eyes or mouth, or trouble breathing: call 911 now (Rosie never places the call); fire: leave and call 911. A mild splash of coral juice or a mild sting with no trouble breathing: rinse with clean water and see a doctor if it doesn't ease.
pf.safety.continue: yes, after the safety steps, when nobody is hurt: a trouble visit sent now where the business takes them, or the next time

pf.first_steps.name: Livestock-loss release for a tank move
pf.first_steps.when: signed on the secure page before the move day
pf.first_steps.why: fish and corals can die in a move even with good care

pf.first_steps.name: Prep for a move or setup
pf.first_steps.what: stop feeding 24 hours before; clear 3 feet around the tank; buckets and towels not needed (the techs bring them)

pf.visit.checkin: the code at the door; on a plan with nobody home, the agreed way in, and DONE with a photo of the tank
pf.visit.changes: extra work, livestock or a replacement part (a heater, a pump) is priced and OK'd by the customer before it's done; a leak or a cracked tank found at the visit stops the work with a written note
pf.visit.done: DONE with the water test numbers and a photo of the tank
pf.visit.dropoff: fish holding: fish bagged and checked in at the counter with the code; READY when they can go home; picked up with the code

pf.money.main: care visits: the saved card charged at DONE; office accounts: one bill a month
pf.money.deposit: 50% of a move or setup quote, the rest on the bill when it's set up
pf.money.fees: A late-cancel or no-show fee, inside 24 hours: $25 at the shop (the card saved for the fish holding and water test), $45 for a care visit, $85 for a trouble visit (its trip and check: one fee per booking, so it's also the visit's late fee), $150 on a tank move with its deposit. The owner's own numbers: the example business's.
pf.money.extras: livestock and parts priced and OK'd by the customer before they're added
pf.money.tax: sales tax on livestock and parts where the state's rules tax goods (a generic switch)
pf.money.two: $2 per confirmed booking applies (D97): a flat fee for each booking Rosie makes.

never: door, alarm, gate or lockbox codes

skills: big or custom systems over 150 gallons
pf.staff.supervision: a new tech works reef systems with a senior tech until the owner OKs them
pf.staff.okWhat: the owner OKs move and setup quotes and any extra over $150
pf.staff.twoPeople: moves and tanks over 75 gallons need two techs: offered only when two are free
pf.staff.standin: another tech with the same skill may stand in for a care visit; a customer who named a tech is never moved on silence

switches: a pet or animal dealer license to sell livestock, where the state's rules require it
sales tax on goods, where the state's rules tax them
pf.rules.records: water test numbers and livestock notes kept with the customer's record

apply: nobody home on a plan visit
a leak found at the visit
fish die after a visit (the business's own livestock guarantee, a claim after the visit)
the power is out at the home
the move day can't go ahead
pf.edges.handling: the generic way; the livestock guarantee is the business's own rule, set in its suggested rules
